purpose: Validate claim-level explanation correctness against structured evidence.

metrics.claim_precision: supported extracted factual claims / all extracted factual claims
metrics.numeric_correctness: numerically correct claims / numerically verifiable claims
metrics.citation_validity: valid cited evidence keys / all cited evidence keys
metrics.decision_consistency: correct ranking/decision claims / verifiable ranking/decision claims

missing_policy: Undefined denominators remain N/A; never substitute zero.
